title: aaas.addition.requested.v1
description: Published by parser once the expression is parsed into an addition of two operands. Consumed by the ledger until P3.4 and by saga-orchestrator from P3.3, which starts AdditionWorkflow(taskId, a, b).

producer.description: The only service allowed to publish this event (contracts/events/topics.psv).

taskId.description: Addition task the event belongs to; never null for this event.

payload.description: The operands of the requested addition. Before commutator (P2.15) the order is the one typed by the user; afterwards a ≥ b, so b is the number of successor calls.

b.description: Second operand, the addend: the number of successor calls.
